name: chaink9
description: Check a token on BNB Smart Chain, Ethereum, Base or Arc for honeypots, hidden taxes and owner traps before buying it. Paid per call in USDC on Base.
long_description: ChainK9 checks a token by doing what a buyer would: it forks the chain and really buys and sells the token through its market (Uniswap or PancakeSwap V2, V3 or V4, hooks included), then runs 60+ checks: honeypot, buy and sell taxes and how they change, owner pause, blacklist, mint and confiscation powers, transfer and sell limits, liquidity, upgrade authority and more. Tools also simulate a trade for a given wallet, test exits, preview a transaction, read liquidity, follow new launches and follow the money out of a transaction. There is no account and no API key: each successful call is paid automatically in USDC on Base with the x402 protocol, from a wallet you choose; failed calls are free. Use a dedicated wallet holding a few dollars of USDC; the per-call and per-day limits below are a second safety net. Results are evidence from a private copy of the chain at one block, not a guarantee and not financial advice.

private_key.title: Base wallet private key
private_key.description: 0x + 64 hex. A NEW, dedicated wallet holding a few dollars of USDC on Base (no ETH needed). Never your main wallet.

max_usd_per_call.title: Max USD per call
max_usd_per_call.description: Any single payment above this is refused. The most expensive tool costs $0.04.

max_usd_per_day.title: Max USD per day
max_usd_per_day.description: Stops paying once this much was spent today (UTC).
